deleteMember.title: Delete {{email}}
deleteMember.body: This permanently removes {{email}} from the Warehouse. This action cannot be undone.

denied.heading: Access unavailable
denied.description: You do not have permission to review access configuration.

archived.alertDescription: Its Roles, members, and records stay readable, but nothing that changes what it owns can be submitted here. Restore it from the Workspace page to resume changes.
archived.reason: This action is unavailable while the Warehouse is archived.

workspaceRoles.empty: This workspace has no custom workspace role yet.

editor.nameDescription: 1–100 characters, unique in this workspace. Differently cased names are distinct.
editor.permissionsDescription: Changes apply to the next authorization decision. None of these permissions grant anything inside a warehouse.
editor.subtitle: {{count}} workspace member holds this role.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{count}} workspace member holds this role. They move to the replacement in the same step.
delete.description_other: {{count}} workspace members hold this role. Every one of them moves to the replacement in the same step.
delete.replacementDescription: Every workspace member holds exactly one workspace role, so a replacement is required.
delete.noticeDescription: Moving members is a role assignment, so deleting an assigned role needs delete and assign permission together.

onlyCustomRefusal.title: Create another custom workspace role first
onlyCustomRefusal.description: This is the only custom workspace role in this workspace, so the members holding it have nowhere to move. Every workspace member holds exactly one workspace role, and the protected workspace owner role is never assigned this way.

assignmentRefusal.title: Also needs permission to assign workspace roles
assignmentRefusal.description: Moving the affected members to a replacement is a workspace role assignment, so deleting an assigned role needs that permission as well. Nothing changed. Deleting a workspace role nobody holds stays available to you.

delete.unassignedDescription: No workspace member holds this role, so no workspace role assignment changes. Only the role itself is deleted.

workspaceRoles.heading: Workspace roles
workspaceRoles.protectedReason: The workspace owner role is system-managed. It is never renamed, deleted, or given different permissions, and workspace ownership moves only through the protected transfer.

workspaceMembers.heading: Workspace members
workspaceMembers.description: {{count}} person holds a workspace role. They hold exactly one.
workspaceMembers.description_other: {{count}} people hold a workspace role. Each holds exactly one.
workspaceMembers.empty: This workspace has no workspace member yet.

changeRole.title: Change the workspace role of {{name}}
changeRole.roleDescription: Every workspace member holds exactly one workspace role.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from the workspace?
remove.description: They keep the warehouses they belong to and stop administering this workspace.

add.title: Add a workspace member
add.description: Only people who already belong to a warehouse of this workspace can be made workspace members.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer workspace ownership
transferOwnership.description: Ownership moves in one step. The workspace always has exactly one owner.
transferOwnership.newOwnerDescription: Must already be a workspace member.
transferOwnership.newRoleDescription: You must end the transfer holding exactly one workspace role.
transferOwnership.noticeDescription: After this you can no longer transfer ownership, and only the new owner can transfer it back.

refusal.title: Create a custom workspace role first
refusal.description: This workspace has no custom workspace role for you to receive, and you must end the transfer holding exactly one workspace role. Nothing changed.

everyone.heading: Everyone in this workspace
everyone.description: People who belong to a warehouse of this workspace. Only they can be made workspace members — and any of them can be given access to another warehouse.
everyone.blockedNote: {{name}} belongs to no warehouse of this workspace yet, so they cannot be made a workspace member until they are given access to one.

workspacePermissions.heading: Workspace permissions
workspacePermissions.description: The workspace permission catalogue. None of these permissions grant anything inside a warehouse.
workspacePermissions.reservedNote: Transferring ownership is reserved for the protected Workspace owner role and cannot be added to a custom role.
